My colleagues and I focused on a less visible part of the problem: the components that deliver power to those transistors. A chip needs more than electricity. It needs electricity supplied at the right voltage, with fluctuations kept under control. Making the hardware that does this smaller is an important challenge—and one that led my colleagues and me to build tiny magnetic devices called stripline microinductors.

Detroit Lions linebacker Jack Campbell was carted off after a scary collision in the game against the Minnesota Vikings. Michigan squeaked out a win over Rutgers on Saturday and dropped two spots in ESPN’s SP+ rankings as a result. Here’s where things stand heading into Week 10: For those of you who might be new to SP+, it's an advanced metric that takes into account a team's offensive, defensive, and special teams efficiencies. It combines all three metrics into one uniform metric that predicts how many points a given team would defeat (or lose to) the "average" college football team by on a neutral field. In other words, it's a metric designed to look at how "good" teams really are at different aspects of the game rather than ranking them purely on their resumes.

Dallas already has a season's worth of tough endings. Halfway through the NFL season, the Dallas Cowboys have already racked up a slew of heartbreaking losses. The NFL hasn't had an undefeated team since the 1972 Dolphins. The 1972 Dolphins, who have the only undefeated season in league history, remain safe for at least another year. And the NFL's business model, built in large part upon on-field parity and "any given Sunday" unpredictability, continues to reign supreme. The league has soaring franchise values and viewership figures that dwarf all others in U.S. professional sports. Many factors contribute to that. But among the biggest are the league's revenue-sharing model and salary cap system that keep the franchises, whether in larger or smaller markets, on relatively even financial footing and maintain competitive balance on the field.

Dozens of shops across European countries have been hit by a cyber-attack affecting their fridges. Supermarkets across Europe have been hit by a suspected cyber-attack affecting their fridges and freezers, and raising concern about the vulnerabilities of internet-connected hardware from industrial machinery to humble domestic appliances. Smart devices which are connected to the internet can include fridges, central heating, and even washing machines. And while that makes them easier to control remotely, in theory, any device which goes online can potentially be exploited by malicious actors.

Your fantasy football league might have its trade deadline coming up. Who should you trade for to get ready for the playoffs? It's not that you can't get any better after the trade deadline, but it only gets harder to find an impact player on waivers when the rest of your league is focused on the same thing. That's why it's nice to buy players with upside now, a few weeks before the deadline. If they go off in November, you'll be able to get more in return than what you paid. If they don't, there's not going to be much opportunity cost in holding them for a breakout into the playoffs.

Provisional Met Office figures just released show the UK had a warmer, wetter and sunnier October than average but quieter weather has now arrived. High pressure has seized control of the UK weather meaning largely dry, settled but chilly autumn conditions will continue this week. Days will bring a mix of patchy cloud, sunny spells and a few showers, with frost and fog expected to form at night - especially in northern and western areas. Temperatures will generally be around or a little below the seasonal norm and it will feel particularly chilly in southern England and south Wales where there will be a brisk easterly breeze.

A federal judge on Friday rejected McDonald’s request to dismiss a proposed class action accusing it of defrauding consumers about the content of its McRib sandwich. The plaintiffs accused McDonald’s of intentionally shaping McRib patties with ridges to resemble pork ribs and make diners believe the sandwich contains rib meat, an expensive cut known for its higher fat content and rich flavor. Consumers said McDonald’s actual use of lower-grade pork products including shoulder, heart, tripe or stomach caused them to overpay for the McRib, one of its most expensive menu items.

Researchers have detected signals from the smallest distances ever probed. Scientists have picked up signals from the smallest scale of nature ever explored – 100 billion times smaller than an atom. The government is launching its first study into the levels of so-called 'forever chemicals' in the UK population. By taking blood and urine samples, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) hopes to gain a better understanding of any potential health risks caused by the substances also known as PFAS, as well as other potential contaminants like lead and arsenic.
